Container.Name: checkrr
Container.Overview:
Scan your library files for corrupt media and replace the files via sonarr and radarr.
Join the Checkrr discord here: `https://discord.gg/dkTfNKbEhJ`
Container.DonateText: If you like our work please consider Donating.
Container.Requires:
1) Create checkrr directory
`mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/checkrr/config`
2) Create and edit checkrr.yaml using the sample from the repository: (remove any unused items)
`wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aetaric/checkrr/refs/heads/main/checkrr.yaml.example -O /mnt/user/appdata/checkrr/config/checkrr.yaml`
`nano /mnt/user/appdata/checkrr/config/checkrr.yaml`
** NOTE: If using this template's default mapping, the database path should be: `/etc/checkrr/checkrr.db` **
3) Optional:
For first-time run, to check files once and exit instead of waiting for the scheduled time. Add the following to your Post Arguments:
`command: -o`
